briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate multi-agent arms race ahead of Q4 releases

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid intense compute competition. Multi-agent systems dominate development pipelines while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind tests Gemini 3.0 internally; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic workflows.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft and xAI expand Memphis supercluster; TSMC allocates 40% capacity to AI accelerators through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will first-mover advantage in multi-agent security protocols determine the 2027 AGI leader?
